later, lateris m.

noun, third declension

Other words

  • later coctilis — fired brick

    also used · classical · Traupman 165

    coctilis has a short i (Lewis & Short coctĭlis).

  • laterīcius, laterīcia, laterīcium — made of brick

    also used · classical · Caes. BC 2.10: turris latericia (Lewis & Short); Traupman 165; Caes. BC 2.10: turris laterīcia (Lewis & Short); Traupman 283

Examples

  • Laterēs struunt.

    They are laying bricks.composed

  • laterēs struere

    to lay bricksTraupman 165
